spec.description: Prometheus Config Sync service health and operational dashboards.

spec.title: Metrics Target
spec.description: Prometheus scrape availability. This is not the /readyz synchronization state.

spec.title: Sync Health
spec.description: Exact synchronization readiness exported by the service and used by /readyz and /healthz.

spec.title: Pending Prometheus Reload
spec.description: Whether a published configuration change is newer than the latest successful Prometheus reload.

spec.title: Unrecovered Failure
spec.description: Whether the latest failed synchronization is newer than the latest successful synchronization.

spec.title: Sync Success Rate 1h
spec.description: Successful synchronization percentage during the last hour; no data is shown when no attempts occurred.

spec.title: Heap Detail
spec.description: Heap breakdown details: system / in-use / idle memory.

spec.title: Sync Attempts / Errors Rate
spec.description: Completed synchronization attempts and stage-classified errors per second.

spec.title: Average Sync Duration
spec.description: Average completed sync duration over Grafana's adaptive rate interval.

spec.title: Config Changes / Reloads Rate
spec.description: Published generated configuration changes and successful Prometheus reloads per second.
